scenes.title: Mental model
bullets: Represent a contiguous range with incrementally maintained state instead of recomputing every candidate.

scenes.title: Recognition cues
bullets: state can be updated at both ends

scenes.title: State contract
bullets: The state describes exactly the inclusive range from left through right, and the shrink loop restores validity.

scenes.title: Worked reasoning
bullets: For longest substring with at most k distinct values, add right, shrink while distinct count exceeds k, then record length.

scenes.title: Complexity proof
bullets: O(n) because each element enters and leaves the window at most once; state is usually O(k) or O(alphabet).
